You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.

You are a coding agent powered by the gpt-5.6-luna model.

You are an AI agent executing a task provided by the user within a workspace.

## Workspace layout

Everything you work with lives under one workspace root. **`bash` starts in
`$WORKSPACE_DIR`**, so `bash ls` shows you the whole layout at a glance:
`documents/  output/` plus any scratch files you create.

- **`$WORKSPACE_DIR`** — your working area, default `bash` cwd. Use it for
  notes and intermediate files.
- **`$DOCUMENTS_DIR`** (`$WORKSPACE_DIR/documents`) — task documents.
  Read-only.
- **`$OUTPUT_DIR`** (`$WORKSPACE_DIR/output`) — deliverables. Save every
  deliverable file here, including files you build with `bash` (.docx,
  .xlsx, .pptx): only files in `$OUTPUT_DIR` are delivered. `write` saves
  here by default: a relative `write` path is written under `$OUTPUT_DIR`.
- **Task configuration** (`task.json`) — contains the task definition and the
  grading rubric. Do not read, search, or reference it. Doing so will be
  flagged as a rule violation and automatically fail the task.

## Tool conventions

- `read` opens plain-text files only (.txt, .md, .eml, .csv, ...). To read
  .docx, .xlsx or .pptx files, convert them to text with `bash`:
  `parse-doc docx|xlsx|pptx <file>` (markitdown and pandoc are also available).
- Use `write` only for plain markdown — typically a `response.md`
  summarizing your work.
- Use `edit` for incremental refinement of a file you have already created.


Check the [exit code: N] marker on every bash result; investigate failures before moving on.

Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat — to inspect text files. Results include line numbers. Use offset and limit to continue reading large files.

Use the write tool to create files or completely replace file contents. Existing files are overwritten, so read an existing file first (the default fs-observation-policy requires it) and prefer edit for targeted changes.

Use the edit tool for targeted changes to existing UTF-8 text files. It replaces literal old_string with new_string; by default old_string must appear exactly once. If old_string appears multiple times, provide a more specific old_string or set replace_all to true. Read the file first (the default fs-observation-policy requires it), unless you just created or edited it in this session.

Use the glob tool — not shell find — to discover files by path pattern. A pattern with no "/" matches basenames at any depth, so "*" matches every file in the tree rather than its top level. Results are files only, never directories, and include hidden and ignored files: a result that fits comes back in modification-time order, while a larger one keeps the modification-time-ordered head.

Use the grep tool — not shell grep or rg — to search file contents. Use read on a matched file when you need surrounding context.

Track every background job id you start. You are notified in-session when a job finishes — do not busy-poll or sleep on one; keep working on independent steps and do not duplicate a running job's work. Before giving a final answer, collect every still-relevant job with job_output (set wait: true only when you are genuinely blocked on it), and job_kill jobs that stopped mattering.

Use goal tools for one long-running completion objective in the current session. create_goal may infer goal intent from a direct human request in any language; do not create a goal for routine single-turn work. Call get_goal before update_goal and copy its exact goal_id and revision. After session resume or fork, an active goal is disarmed: when a human asks to continue or resume in any wording or language, use update_goal action resume to rearm it. Mark complete only when the objective is actually achieved. Mark blocked only after the same blocking condition persists for at least 3 consecutive goal rounds, and report that concrete condition in blocked_reason; difficulty, uncertainty, or useful remaining work is not blocked.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell: no state (cwd, variables, functions) persists between calls — pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Non-zero exits are reported as `[exit code: N]`. Current harness environment facts are exposed through managed `$DSH_*` variables; inspect them when needed. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]` — a policy denial, not a bug in the command; do not retry another way. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Set `run_in_background: true` for long-running commands: the call returns a job id immediately; read its output with `job_output` and stop it with `job_kill`.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm install" → "Install package dependencies".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap, and kills the command on expiry.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create one persisted same-session completion goal when the current direct human request is a long-running objective that should continue across autonomous goal rounds. You may infer that intent without requiring the user to say "create a goal". Do not use this for trivial single-turn work. Execution rejects non-human and subagent authority.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

old_string.description: Literal text to replace. Must match exactly.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. Send the COMPLETE plan as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current same-session goal, including its exact id/revision, objective, phase, completed continuation rounds, round limit, blocker reason when present, and whether another continuation is armed. Call this before updating a goal.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files whose paths match a glob pattern. Returns matching file paths — never directories — including hidden and ignored files (VCS metadata directories are excluded). Up to 100 paths come back in modification-time order; a larger result returns the first 100 paths in modification-time order, says so, and reports where the complete sorted list was saved. This tool does not enumerate directory entries.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns the first 250 matches inline; a capped result reports where the complete match list was saved. Use read on a matched file for surrounding context.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job by job id. Returns immediately; the job settles as killed once its work actually stops.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job. Stream jobs return only output since the previous read; final-output jobs return their result after settlement. Every response ends with `[status: ...]`. Reads are non-blocking unless `wait: true`, which waits up to the configured cap.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job reaches a terminal status or the timeout expires. A timed-out wait returns [status: running] and leaves the job alive.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds (only meaningful with wait: true). Defaults to the configured wait timeout; capped by the configured maximum.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. A path without a file extension is accepted; the format is detected from the file content, so normalized attachment paths can be passed directly without copying or renaming. Harness validates and downscales large supported images before the next model request, so use this tool directly instead of installing image libraries or creating thumbnails merely to inspect an image. Independent files may be read concurrently in small batches. Requires the current model to accept image input.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Load the full instructions for an available skill. Call this with the exact skill name from the session skill catalog before acting on a task that names or clearly matches that skill.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Record and update a structured task list for the current work. Send the ENTIRE list every call — it REPLACES the previous list (there are no partial updates, no per-item edits). Use it to plan multi-step work and show progress: add one todo per concrete step before you start. Mark every todo being actively worked on `in_progress` — several at once when work genuinely runs in parallel (e.g. concurrent subagents or background commands), one for sequential work; while work remains, at least one task should be `in_progress`. Mark a todo `completed` the moment it is done (do not batch completions), and allow no `in_progress` item only once all work is complete. Skip the list for trivial single-step tasks. Statuses: `pending` (not started), `in_progress` (being worked on now), `completed` (finished).

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update the exact current goal revision. edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. During an automatic continuation of the current goal, complete and blocked are also allowed. blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count; the model remains responsible for judging that the same condition persisted across those rounds and must explain it in blocked_reason.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Concrete blocking condition; required only with action blocked.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file. A relative path is written under the output directory (`output/`): `response.md` is saved as `output/response.md`. An absolute path is used as is.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

1: **[DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT]{.underline}**
2: 
3: **Pinnacle Capital Partners Standard Form** *(pinnacle-form-aca.docx)*
4: 
5: **[DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT]{.underline}**
6: 
7: This DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT (this \"Agreement\") is entered into as of **\_\_**, 20\_\_ (the \"Effective Date\"), by and among the following parties:
8: 
9: **SECURED PARTY:**
10: 
11: > Pinnacle Capital Partners, LP, a Delaware limited partnership, and its successors and assigns (the \"Secured Party\");
12: 
13: **DEPOSITOR / DEBTOR:**
14: 
15: > **\_\_\_\_\_***, a* **\_\_\_\_\_** (the \"Depositor\" or \"Debtor\"); and
16: 
17: **DEPOSITORY BANK:**
18: 
19: > **\_\_\_\_\_**\_, a national banking association chartered under the laws of the United States (the \"Bank\").
20: 
21: Each of the Secured Party, the Depositor, and the Bank is sometimes referred to herein individually as a \"Party\" and collectively as the \"Parties.\"
22: 
23: **[RECITALS]{.underline}**
24: 
25: **WHEREAS**, Depositor maintains one or more deposit accounts at Bank, each as more particularly identified and described on Schedule A attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference (collectively, the \"Accounts\" and each individually, an \"Account\");
26: 
27: **WHEREAS**, Secured Party has been granted a security interest in, and lien upon, such Accounts and all funds, cash, instruments, investment property, and other property at any time credited thereto, pursuant to that certain Credit Agreement dated as of **\_\_**, 20\_\_, by and between Depositor and Secured Party, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, together with all related security agreements, pledge agreements, guaranties, and ancillary documents executed in connection therewith (collectively, the \"Loan Documents\");
28: 
29: **WHEREAS**, the Parties desire to enter into this Agreement to establish \"control\" (as such term is defined and used in Articles 8 and 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of New York) by the Secured Party over the Accounts in order to perfect the security interest of the Secured Party therein; and
30: 
31: **WHEREAS**, Bank is willing to enter into this Agreement on the terms and conditions set forth herein.
32: 
33: **NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the mutual covenants, representations, and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereby agree as follows:
34: 
35: **[Section 1 --- Definitions]{.underline}**
36: 
37: As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Loan Documents or, if not defined therein, in the UCC.
38: 
39: **\"Account\"** or **\"Deposit Account\"** means each deposit account identified on Schedule A hereto, including any and all renewals, replacements, reclassifications, redesignations, or successor accounts thereof, howsoever denominated, and all funds, cash, instruments, chattel paper, investment property, general intangibles, and other property at any time credited to, deposited in, held in, or otherwise attributable to any such account, together with all interest, dividends, income, and other earnings thereon and all proceeds (as defined in the UCC) thereof.
40: 
41: **\"Business Day\"** means any day on which Bank is open for the conduct of substantially all of its commercial banking business at its offices in New York, New York, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and any day on which banking institutions in the State of New York are authorized or required by law or executive order to close.
42: 
43: **\"Entitlement Order\"** has the meaning ascribed to such term in UCC Section 8-102(a)(8), and shall include any notification communicated to Bank directing the transfer, redemption, liquidation, or other disposition of a financial asset or interest therein, including without limitation any instruction originated by Secured Party pursuant to Section 3 of this Agreement.
44: 
45: **\"Event of Default\"** means an \"Event of Default\" as defined in, and determined in accordance with, the Loan Documents, or as otherwise notified by Secured Party to Bank pursuant to a Notice of Exclusive Control delivered in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, Bank shall have no obligation or duty to independently determine whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Loan Documents.
46: 
47: **\"Exclusive Control Notice\"** or **\"Notice of Exclusive Control\"** (each, an **\"NOEC\"**) means a written notice delivered by Secured Party to Bank in accordance with Section 10 hereof, substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A (if any), asserting that an Event of Default has occurred under the Loan Documents and directing Bank to comply exclusively with Instructions originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, and to cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor.
48: 
49: **\"Instructions\"** means any order, direction, instruction, request, or authorization regarding the disposition of funds in, or any other action to be taken or omitted with respect to, any Account, including without limitation directions to initiate or execute wire transfers, ACH transactions, checks, withdrawals, transfers between accounts, account closings, and the provision of account statements, balance information, and other account-related information.
50: 
51: **\"Lien\"** means any security interest, lien, pledge, hypothecation, charge, mortgage, encumbrance, attachment, garnishment, levy, claim, right of set-off, right of recoupment, banker\'s lien, right of combination of accounts, or other interest or right of any kind, whether arising by contract, operation of law, equity, or otherwise.
52: 
53: **\"Loan Documents\"** means, collectively, the credit agreement, loan agreement, security agreement, and all related agreements, instruments, certificates, and documents between or among Depositor and Secured Party (and any guarantors or other obligors party thereto), as the same may be amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, replaced, refinanced, or otherwise modified from time to time, including without limitation any intercreditor agreements, subordination agreements, and collateral documents executed in connection therewith.
54: 
55: **\"UCC\"** means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in the State of New York; provided that, to the extent that the UCC is used to define any term herein and such term is defined differently in different Articles or Divisions of the UCC, the definition of such term contained in Article 9 shall govern. In the event that, by reason of mandatory provisions of law, any of the attachment, perfection, or priority of the Secured Party\'s security interest in any Account is governed by the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted and in effect in a jurisdiction other than the State of New York, the term \"UCC\" shall mean the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted and in effect in such other jurisdiction solely for purposes of the provisions hereof relating to such attachment, perfection, or priority and for purposes of definitions relating to such provisions.
56: 
57: All other capitalized terms used in this Agreement and not specifically defined herein shall have the meanings assigned to such terms in the Loan Documents. To the extent a term is defined both in this Agreement and in the Loan Documents, the definition set forth in this Agreement shall control for purposes of this Agreement.
58: 
59: **[Section 2 --- The Accounts; Establishment of Control]{.underline}**
60: 
61: **2.1 Confirmation of Accounts.** Bank hereby confirms and acknowledges that (a) each Account listed on Schedule A hereto is maintained at Bank, (b) each such Account is held in the name of Depositor as the account holder of record, (c) each such Account constitutes a \"deposit account\" and/or \"securities account\" (as applicable) within the meaning of the UCC, and (d) Bank is the \"bank\" (as defined in UCC Section 9-102(a)(8)) with respect to each such Account.
62: 
63: **2.2 Establishment of Control.** Bank hereby agrees that, from and after the Effective Date, it will comply with Instructions originated by Secured Party directing the disposition of funds in the Accounts without further consent of Depositor, thereby establishing \"control\" by Secured Party over the Accounts within the meaning of UCC Sections 9-104(a)(2) and 8-106 (to the extent applicable). Bank acknowledges and agrees that such compliance obligation is unconditional and shall not be subject to any conditions precedent other than the delivery of such Instructions in a manner consistent with Section 10 of this Agreement. The Parties intend that this Agreement shall satisfy all requirements for the establishment and perfection of control by Secured Party over the Accounts under the UCC, and each Party agrees to take such further actions and execute such additional documents as may be reasonably necessary to effectuate such intent.
64: 
65: **2.3 No Changes to Accounts Without Consent.** Bank shall not, without the prior written consent of Secured Party, (a) change the name, account number, title, designation, or ownership of any Account, (b) close, terminate, or redesignate any Account, (c) open any new account for Depositor that is intended to be subject to this Agreement, (d) merge, combine, or consolidate any Account with any other account or obligation of Depositor at Bank, or (e) permit any change to the authorized signatories on any Account if such change has been objected to in writing by Secured Party.
66: 
67: **2.4 Depositor\'s Consent.** Depositor hereby irrevocably authorizes and consents to Bank\'s compliance with all Instructions originated by Secured Party, including without limitation all Entitlement Orders, without any obligation of Bank to inquire into the right, authority, or entitlement of Secured Party to issue such Instructions, and without any obligation of Bank to provide notice to Depositor of its receipt or execution of any such Instructions. Depositor acknowledges that Bank shall have no liability to Depositor for complying with any Instruction or Entitlement Order originated by Secured Party in accordance with the terms of this Agreement.
68: 
69: **[Section 3 --- Exclusive Control Upon Event of Default]{.underline}**
70: 
71: **3.1 Depositor\'s Rights Prior to Notice of Exclusive Control.** Prior to the delivery by Secured Party to Bank of a Notice of Exclusive Control, Bank shall continue to comply with Instructions originated by Depositor with respect to the Accounts in the ordinary course of business, including without limitation Instructions relating to wire transfers, ACH transactions, check payments, withdrawals, transfers, and other customary banking transactions; *provided*, however, that such compliance shall at all times be subject to (a) any standing limitations, restrictions, or blocked account instructions separately communicated in writing by Secured Party to Bank from time to time, and (b) the obligation of Bank to comply with all Instructions originated by Secured Party as set forth in Section 2.2 hereof. In the event of any conflict between Instructions of Depositor and any standing limitations or Instructions of Secured Party received by Bank prior to delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control, the provisions of Section 4 shall apply.
72: 
73: **3.2 Effect of Notice of Exclusive Control.** Upon receipt by Bank of a Notice of Exclusive Control from Secured Party delivered in accordance with Section 10 of this Agreement:
74: 
75: > \(a\) Bank shall immediately cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, and shall reject, refuse to honor, and return unpaid any checks, drafts, ACH debits, wire transfer requests, withdrawal requests, or other payment orders or instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor that are presented to or received by Bank on or after the date of Bank\'s compliance with the Notice of Exclusive Control;
76: >
77: > \(b\) Bank shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, including without limitation Instructions directing:
78: >
79: > \(i\) wire transfers of funds from any Account to any account designated by Secured Party;
80: >
81: > \(ii\) ACH debits and credits with respect to any Account;
82: >
83: > \(iii\) withdrawals of funds from any Account by any means;
84: >
85: > \(iv\) the closing of any or all Accounts and the remittance of all remaining balances to Secured Party or as Secured Party may direct;
86: >
87: > \(v\) the redirection of all account statements, balance information, transaction reports, and other correspondence and information relating to the Accounts exclusively to Secured Party at the address specified by Secured Party; and
88: >
89: > \(vi\) any other action with respect to the Accounts as Secured Party may direct from time to time;
90: >
91: > \(c\) Bank shall freeze and block all automated or preauthorized debits, standing payment orders, and recurring transactions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, unless and until Secured Party provides written Instructions to the contrary; and
92: >
93: > \(d\) Bank shall provide Secured Party with a complete and current statement of the balance and recent transaction history for each Account promptly upon request.
94: 
95: **3.3 NOEC Compliance Period.** Bank shall comply with a Notice of Exclusive Control within two (2) Business Days of receipt thereof (the \"NOEC Compliance Period\"). During the NOEC Compliance Period, Bank shall use commercially reasonable efforts to implement the notice as promptly as practicable and shall not permit any new debits, withdrawals, or transfers initiated by Depositor to be processed from the Accounts after the first Business Day following receipt of the Notice of Exclusive Control; *provided*, however, that Bank shall not be liable for checks, ACH entries, or wire transfers that were irrevocably initiated or submitted into a payment system prior to the expiration of the NOEC Compliance Period and that settle or clear after such period, so long as Bank acted in good faith and used commercially reasonable efforts to prevent such transactions from clearing.
96: 
97: **3.4 No Requirement of Proof.** Bank shall not require Secured Party to present evidence of the occurrence or continuance of an Event of Default, a court order, a judgment, a certificate from Depositor, or any other documentation whatsoever as a condition to Bank\'s compliance with a Notice of Exclusive Control. Bank\'s sole obligation upon receipt of a Notice of Exclusive Control shall be to verify that such notice is in writing, purports to come from Secured Party (or an authorized representative thereof), is directed to Bank in accordance with Section 10, and requests Bank to comply exclusively with Instructions of Secured Party. Upon such verification, Bank shall be fully authorized and directed to comply with the Notice of Exclusive Control, and Bank shall have no duty to make any further inquiry or investigation.
98: 
99: **3.5 Depositor\'s Waiver.** Depositor hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives any right to challenge, contest, object to, or otherwise dispute Bank\'s compliance with any Notice of Exclusive Control or any Instruction or Entitlement Order originated by Secured Party in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. Depositor acknowledges that any remedy or recourse Depositor may have in connection with the issuance of a Notice of Exclusive Control or the exercise by Secured Party of its rights hereunder shall be solely against Secured Party and not against Bank, and Depositor shall not assert any claim against Bank arising out of or related to Bank\'s compliance with any Instruction or Entitlement Order originated by Secured Party.
100: 
101: **3.6 Rescission of Notice of Exclusive Control.** A Notice of Exclusive Control shall remain in effect until Secured Party delivers a written notice to Bank rescinding or withdrawing the Notice of Exclusive Control (a \"Rescission Notice\"). Upon receipt by Bank of a Rescission Notice, the provisions of Section 3.1 shall again apply, and Bank shall resume complying with Instructions of Depositor in the ordinary course of business, subject to the continuing obligations of Bank under Section 2.2 hereof. Bank shall comply with a Rescission Notice within two (2) Business Days of receipt thereof.
102: 
103: **[Section 4 --- Conflicting Instructions; Waterfall]{.underline}**
104: 
105: **4.1 Priority of Instructions.** In the event of any conflict between Instructions received by Bank from Secured Party and Instructions received by Bank from Depositor with respect to any Account, at all times (whether or not a Notice of Exclusive Control has been delivered and whether or not a Notice of Exclusive Control is then in effect), the Instructions of Secured Party shall control and prevail over any inconsistent or conflicting Instructions of Depositor. Bank shall resolve any such conflict in accordance with the following waterfall priority:
106: 
107: > \(a\) **First:** Instructions of Secured Party shall be given first priority and shall be complied with immediately, without regard to any conflicting Instructions from Depositor;
108: >
109: > \(b\) **Second:** Instructions of Depositor shall be given second priority and shall be complied with only to the extent (i) such Instructions are not inconsistent with, and do not conflict with, any Instructions previously or concurrently received from Secured Party, and (ii) no Notice of Exclusive Control is then in effect.
110: 
111: **4.2 Notification of Conflicts.** Bank shall promptly, and in any event within one (1) Business Day, notify Secured Party in writing of any conflicting, inconsistent, or potentially inconsistent Instructions received by Bank from Depositor with respect to any Account, and shall provide Secured Party with a copy of or reasonable description of such conflicting Instructions. Bank shall await further direction from Secured Party before acting on any Instruction from Depositor that Bank reasonably believes may conflict with or be inconsistent with any Instruction previously received from Secured Party, unless Bank determines in good faith that delaying action on such Instruction would cause Bank to violate applicable law or regulation.
112: 
113: **4.3 No Duty to Inquire.** Bank shall have no duty to inquire into the propriety, authorization, validity, or legal effect of any Instruction received from Secured Party. Bank shall be entitled to rely conclusively upon any Instruction purporting to originate from Secured Party (or an authorized representative thereof) and delivered in accordance with Section 10 hereof, and Bank shall have no liability to Depositor or any other person for so relying and complying with such Instruction.
114: 
115: **[Section 5 --- Subordination of Bank Liens; Waiver of Set-Off]{.underline}**
116: 
117: **5.1 Subordination and Release.** Bank hereby irrevocably and unconditionally subordinates, releases, and waives any and all Liens (whether now existing or hereafter arising, whether arising by contract, operation of law, banker\'s lien, right of recoupment, statutory lien, security agreement, or otherwise) that Bank may now or hereafter have in, to, or with respect to the Accounts or any funds, property, or proceeds therein, in favor of the security interest and Lien of Secured Party in the Accounts. Bank acknowledges and agrees that the security interest and Lien of Secured Party in the Accounts shall at all times be senior and prior in right and priority to any Lien or interest of Bank in the Accounts.
118: 
119: **5.2 Waiver of Set-Off.** Bank hereby irrevocably waives any right of set-off, netting, combination of accounts, counterclaim, deduction, or retention against any Account or any funds therein, whether arising under any agreement between Bank and Depositor, under common law, equity, statute, regulation, or otherwise. Without limiting the foregoing, Bank agrees that it will not exercise, assert, or enforce any such right against any Account or funds therein without the prior written consent of Secured Party.
120: 
121: **5.3 Permitted Exceptions.** Notwithstanding Sections 5.1 and 5.2, Bank shall retain its rights with respect to the following limited exceptions:
122: 
123: > \(a\) Bank\'s standard published account maintenance fees, service charges, and transaction fees applicable to the Accounts in accordance with Bank\'s standard fee schedule as provided to Depositor from time to time in the ordinary course; and
124: >
125: > \(b\) the right to charge back to the Accounts any returned, reversed, dishonored, or charged-back items (including returned deposited checks, reversed ACH entries, and recalled wire transfers) credited to the Accounts in error or subject to return under applicable law or clearing house rules;
126: >
127: > *provided*, however, that in no event shall the aggregate amount of fees deducted or items charged back by Bank pursuant to clauses (a) and (b) above exceed \$**\_\_** in the aggregate during any calendar month without the prior written consent of Secured Party. Bank shall provide Secured Party with a monthly summary of all fees deducted and items charged back pursuant to this Section 5.3 promptly upon request.
128: 
129: **5.4 Material Inducement.** Bank acknowledges and agrees that the subordination, release, and waivers set forth in this Section 5 are a material inducement to Secured Party entering into the Loan Documents, extending credit to Depositor, and accepting the Accounts as collateral, and that Secured Party has entered into the Loan Documents and extended credit to Depositor in reliance upon such subordination, release, and waivers.
130: 
131: **[Section 6 --- Representations and Warranties]{.underline}**
132: 
133: **Section 6.1 --- Representations and Warranties of Bank**
134: 
135: Bank hereby represents and warrants to Secured Party and Depositor, as of the Effective Date and as of each date on which this Agreement remains in effect, as follows:
136: 
137: > \(a\) **Organization and Authority.** Bank is a national banking association duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of the United States. Bank has full power, authority, and legal right to enter into this Agreement, to perform its obligations hereunder, and to carry out the transactions contemplated hereby. The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement by Bank have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate or organizational action on the part of Bank.
138: >
139: > \(b\) **Exclusive Control; No Other Agreements.** The Accounts are solely in the name of Depositor, and no other person or entity (other than Secured Party pursuant to this Agreement) has been granted control (within the meaning of the UCC) over the Accounts. Bank has not entered into, and covenants that it will not enter into, any other control agreement, blocked account agreement, escrow agreement, or similar agreement or arrangement with respect to the Accounts without the prior written consent of Secured Party.
140: >
141: > \(c\) **No Other Liens or Claims.** Bank has received no notice of any Lien, claim, interest, or adverse claim in, to, or with respect to the Accounts other than the security interest and Lien of Secured Party as contemplated hereby. Bank is not aware of any pending or threatened claim, demand, action, or proceeding against or affecting the Accounts.
142: >
143: > \(d\) **Bank\'s Jurisdiction.** Bank\'s jurisdiction for purposes of UCC Section 9-304 is the State of New York. Bank agrees that it will not change its jurisdiction (as determined under UCC Section 9-304) without providing Secured Party at least thirty (30) days\' prior written notice thereof.
144: >
145: > \(e\) **No Existing Defaults or Claims.** As of the Effective Date, there are no existing conditions of default, events of default, or outstanding set-off claims or counterclaims by Bank with respect to the Accounts or any funds therein. Bank has no present intention to exercise any right of set-off, combination, or counterclaim with respect to the Accounts.
146: >
147: > \(f\) **Enforceability.** This Agreement constitutes a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Bank, enforceable against Bank in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to general principles of equity (whether considered in a proceeding in equity or at law).
148: 
149: **Section 6.2 --- Representations and Warranties of Depositor**
150: 
151: Depositor hereby represents and warrants to Secured Party and Bank, as of the Effective Date and as of each date on which this Agreement remains in effect, as follows:
152: 
153: > \(a\) **Ownership.** Depositor is the sole and exclusive legal and beneficial owner of the Accounts and all funds, property, and proceeds therein, free and clear of all Liens other than the security interest and Lien of Secured Party as contemplated by the Loan Documents and this Agreement.
154: >
155: > \(b\) **No Prior Control Agreements.** Depositor has not granted control of, or any Lien on, the Accounts (or any funds therein) to any person or entity other than Secured Party. There are no prior or existing control agreements, blocked account agreements, notices of lien, tax levies, garnishments, or adverse claims affecting the Accounts, other than this Agreement.
156: >
157: > \(c\) **Organization and Authority.** Depositor is a **\_\_\_\_\_** *duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of* **\_\_\_\_\_**. Depositor has full power, authority, and legal right to enter into this Agreement, to grant Secured Party control over the Accounts as contemplated hereby, and to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement by Depositor have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate, limited liability company, partnership, or other organizational action on the part of Depositor.
158: >
159: > \(d\) **No Conflicts.** The execution, delivery, and performance by Depositor of this Agreement do not and will not (i) violate, conflict with, or result in a breach of any provision of Depositor\'s organizational documents, (ii) violate, conflict with, or result in a breach or default under any agreement, contract, instrument, or obligation to which Depositor is a party or by which Depositor or its property is bound, or (iii) violate any applicable law, rule, regulation, order, judgment, or decree.
160: >
161: > \(e\) **Enforceability.** This Agreement constitutes a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Depositor, enforceable against Depositor in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to general principles of equity (whether considered in a proceeding in equity or at law).
162: 
163: **[Section 7 --- Secured Party Indemnification of Bank]{.underline}**
164: 
165: **7.1 Secured Party Indemnification.** Secured Party agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Bank and its officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives (each, a \"Bank Indemnitee\") from and against any and all losses, claims, damages, liabilities, deficiencies, judgments, settlements, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys\' fees and disbursements, court costs, and expenses of investigation) (collectively, \"Losses\") incurred by, imposed upon, or asserted against any Bank Indemnitee arising out of, resulting from, or related to:
166: 
167: > \(a\) Bank\'s compliance with any Instructions or Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party pursuant to this Agreement;
168: >
169: > \(b\) Bank\'s compliance with any Notice of Exclusive Control delivered by Secured Party pursuant to Section 3 of this Agreement;
170: >
171: > \(c\) any action taken or omitted by Bank in good faith reliance upon this Agreement or upon any notice, instruction, direction, certificate, or other document furnished by or on behalf of Secured Party hereunder; and
172: >
173: > \(d\) any claim by Depositor or any third party arising out of or relating to Bank\'s compliance with Instructions or directions of Secured Party or Bank\'s refusal to comply with Instructions of Depositor following delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control.
174: 
175: **7.2 Exclusions.** Notwithstanding the foregoing, the indemnification obligations of Secured Party under Section 7.1 shall not extend to, and no Bank Indemnitee shall be entitled to indemnification with respect to, any Losses to the extent such Losses are determined by a court of competent jurisdiction in a final, non-appealable judgment to have resulted from (a) the gross negligence of such Bank Indemnitee, (b) the willful misconduct or fraud of such Bank Indemnitee, or (c) a material breach by Bank of its representations, warranties, covenants, or obligations under this Agreement.
176: 
177: **7.3 Depositor Indemnification.** Depositor also agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless each Bank Indemnitee from and against any and all Losses incurred by, imposed upon, or asserted against any Bank Indemnitee arising out of or related to (a) any breach by Depositor of any representation, warranty, covenant, or obligation of Depositor contained in this Agreement, (b) any inaccuracy in any representation or warranty made by Depositor herein, or (c) any claim by a third party arising out of or relating to the Accounts or the funds therein, to the extent such claim does not arise from the acts or omissions of Bank or Secured Party. The indemnification obligations of Depositor under this Section 7.3 shall be independent of, and in addition to, the indemnification obligations of Secured Party under Section 7.1, and Bank may seek indemnification from either or both of Secured Party and Depositor, as applicable, without regard to the order of priority or any requirement of exhaustion.
178: 
179: **7.4 Indemnification Procedure.** Any Bank Indemnitee seeking indemnification under this Section 7 shall promptly notify the indemnifying party in writing of the claim, demand, action, or proceeding giving rise to such indemnification obligation; *provided*, however, that the failure to provide such notice shall not relieve the indemnifying party of its indemnification obligations except to the extent the indemnifying party is materially prejudiced by such failure. The indemnifying party shall have the right, at its sole cost and expense, to assume the defense of any such claim, demand, action, or proceeding, subject to the right of the Bank Indemnitee to retain separate counsel at the indemnifying party\'s expense if the Bank Indemnitee reasonably determines that a conflict of interest exists.
180: 
181: **[Section 8 --- Limitation of Liability]{.underline}**
182: 
183: **8.1 Consequential Damages.** In no event shall Bank be liable to Secured Party, Depositor, or any other person for any indirect, consequential, incidental, special, punitive, or exemplary damages of any kind whatsoever, including without limitation lost profits, loss of business opportunity, or loss of goodwill, regardless of the form of action and whether or not Bank has been advised of the possibility of such damages.
184: 
185: **8.2 Aggregate Liability Cap.** Bank\'s aggregate liability under or in connection with this Agreement, whether arising in contract, tort, strict liability, or otherwise, shall not exceed the lesser of (a) \$**\_\_** and (b) the aggregate amount of fees actually received by Bank in connection with the maintenance and servicing of the Accounts during the twelve (12) month period immediately preceding the date of the event, act, or omission giving rise to such liability. The foregoing limitation shall not apply to Losses resulting from Bank\'s gross negligence, willful misconduct, or fraud.
186: 
187: **8.3 No Duty to Monitor.** Bank shall have no duty or obligation to (a) monitor or audit the Accounts, the transactions therein, or the use of funds in the Accounts, (b) verify the identity or authority of any person or entity issuing Instructions on behalf of Secured Party or Depositor, beyond Bank\'s standard authentication procedures, (c) determine whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Loan Documents, (d) inquire into the purpose, propriety, or legality of any Instruction, or (e) monitor or enforce compliance by Depositor or Secured Party with any of the terms of the Loan Documents or any other agreement between or among Depositor and Secured Party.
188: 
189: **8.4 Good Faith Reliance.** Bank may rely on the genuineness and authority of any notice, instruction, certificate, statement, direction, or other document or communication reasonably believed by it in good faith to be genuine and to have been signed, sent, or transmitted by an authorized person of the party purporting to have originated such document or communication. Bank shall not be liable for any action taken or omitted in good faith in reliance upon any such document or communication.
190: 
191: **8.5 No Fiduciary Duty.** Secured Party acknowledges and agrees that Bank is acting solely in its capacity as a depository bank and custodian of the Accounts, and that Bank does not owe, and shall not be deemed to owe, any fiduciary duty, duty of loyalty, duty of care, or other duty of any kind to Secured Party, whether arising under this Agreement, the UCC, common law, equity, or otherwise, except as expressly set forth in this Agreement.
192: 
193: **[Section 9 --- Successor Bank; Notification Obligations]{.underline}**
194: 
195: **9.1 Restrictions on Transfer and Succession.** Bank shall not assign, transfer, delegate, or otherwise dispose of the Accounts, or its obligations, duties, or rights under this Agreement, or merge with, consolidate into, or transfer substantially all of its deposit-taking operations or assets to another banking institution or entity (a \"Successor Bank\"), without providing Secured Party at least thirty (30) days\' prior written notice of such proposed assignment, transfer, merger, consolidation, or succession (a \"Succession Event\"). Upon any such Succession Event, and as a condition precedent to the effectiveness thereof (to the extent within Bank\'s control), Bank shall cause the Successor Bank to assume in writing all obligations, duties, and liabilities of Bank under this Agreement, in a written instrument of assumption in form and substance reasonably acceptable to Secured Party. Until such assumption has been executed and delivered to Secured Party, Bank shall remain fully obligated under this Agreement with respect to the Accounts.
196: 
197: **9.2 Notification Obligations.** Bank shall promptly, and in no event later than five (5) Business Days after becoming aware of the occurrence of any of the following events, notify Secured Party in writing of:
198: 
199: > \(a\) any attachment, levy, garnishment, tax lien, or other legal process served on Bank with respect to any Account or any funds therein;
200: >

202: >
203: > \(c\) any change in the account numbers assigned to any Account, whether resulting from a system migration, regulatory requirement, or otherwise;

205: > \(d\) any dishonored, returned, reversed, or charged-back item charged to any Account in an amount in excess of \$**\_\_** individually or \$**\_\_** in the aggregate during any calendar month;
206: >
207: > \(e\) any material change in Bank\'s standard terms and conditions, fee schedule, or account agreements applicable to the Accounts that could reasonably be expected to affect Secured Party\'s rights or interests hereunder; and
208: >
209: > \(f\) any regulatory action, cease and desist order, consent order, or similar enforcement action directed at Bank that could reasonably be expected to materially impair Bank\'s ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement.

300:

There are no conditions, warranties, representations, or other agreements among the Parties in connection with the subject matter of this Agreement, whether oral or written, express or implied, except as specifically set forth herein.

In the event of any such determination, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to modify this Agreement so as to effect the original intent of the Parties as closely as possible in an acceptable manner, so that the transactions contemplated hereby are consummated as originally contemplated to the greatest extent possible.

Delivery of an executed counterpart of a signature page to this Agreement by facsimile transmission, by electronic mail in \"portable document format\" (.pdf) form, or by any other electronic means intended to preserve the original graphic and pictorial appearance of a document, shall be effective as delivery of an originally executed counterpart of this Agreement. **[DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT]{.underline}**
This DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT (this \"Agreement\") is entered into as of **\_\_**, 20\_\_ (the \"Effective Date\"), by and among the following parties:
**SECURED PARTY:**
> Pinnacle Capital Partners, LP, a Delaware limited partnership, and its successors and assigns (the \"Secured Party\");
**DEPOSITOR / DEBTOR:**
**DEPOSITORY BANK:**
> **\_\_\_\_\_**\_, a national banking association chartered under the laws of the United States (the \"Bank\").
Each of the Secured Party, the Depositor, and the Bank is sometimes referred to herein individually as a \"Party\" and collectively as the \"Parties.\"
**[RECITALS]{.underline}**

**WHEREAS**, Depositor maintains one or more deposit accounts at Bank, each as more particularly identified and described on Schedule A attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference (collectively, the \"Accounts\" and each individually, an \"Account\");

**WHEREAS**, Secured Party has been granted a security interest in, and lien upon, such Accounts and all funds, cash, instruments, investment property, and other property at any time credited thereto, pursuant to that certain Credit Agreement dated as of **\_\_**, 20\_\_, by and between Depositor and Secured Party, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, together with all related security agreements, pledge agreements, guaranties, and ancillary documents executed in connection therewith (collectively, the \"Loan Documents\");

**WHEREAS**, the Parties desire to enter into this Agreement to establish \"control\" (as such term is defined and used in Articles 8 and 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of New York) by the Secured Party over the Accounts in order to perfect the security interest of the Secured Party therein; and
**WHEREAS**, Bank is willing to enter into this Agreement on the terms and conditions set forth herein.

**NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the mutual covenants, representations, and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereby agree as follows:
**[Section 1 --- Definitions]{.underline}**

As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Loan Documents or, if not defined therein, in the UCC.

**\"Account\"** or **\"Deposit Account\"** means each deposit account identified on Schedule A hereto, including any and all renewals, replacements, reclassifications, redesignations, or successor accounts thereof, howsoever denominated, and all funds, cash, instruments, chattel paper, investment property, general intangibles, and other property at any time credited to, deposited in, held in, or otherwise attributable to any such account, together with all interest, dividends, income, and other earnings thereon and all proceeds (as defined in the UCC) thereof.

**\"Business Day\"** means any day on which Bank is open for the conduct of substantially all of its commercial banking business at its offices in New York, New York, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and any day on which banking institutions in the State of New York are authorized or required by law or executive order to close.

**\"Entitlement Order\"** has the meaning ascribed to such term in UCC Section 8-102(a)(8), and shall include any notification communicated to Bank directing the transfer, redemption, liquidation, or other disposition of a financial asset or interest therein, including without limitation any instruction originated by Secured Party pursuant to Section 3 of this Agreement.

**\"Event of Default\"** means an \"Event of Default\" as defined in, and determined in accordance with, the Loan Documents, or as otherwise notified by Secured Party to Bank pursuant to a Notice of Exclusive Control delivered in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, Bank shall have no obligation or duty to independently determine whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Loan Documents.

**\"Exclusive Control Notice\"** or **\"Notice of Exclusive Control\"** (each, an **\"NOEC\"**) means a written notice delivered by Secured Party to Bank in accordance with Section 10 hereof, substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A (if any), asserting that an Event of Default has occurred under the Loan Documents and directing Bank to comply exclusively with Instructions originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, and to cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor.

**\"Instructions\"** means any order, direction, instruction, request, or authorization regarding the disposition of funds in, or any other action to be taken or omitted with respect to, any Account, including without limitation directions to initiate or execute wire transfers, ACH transactions, checks, withdrawals, transfers between accounts, account closings, and the provision of account statements, balance information, and other account-related information.

**\"Lien\"** means any security interest, lien, pledge, hypothecation, charge, mortgage, encumbrance, attachment, garnishment, levy, claim, right of set-off, right of recoupment, banker\'s lien, right of combination of accounts, or other interest or right of any kind, whether arising by contract, operation of law, equity, or otherwise.

**\"Loan Documents\"** means, collectively, the credit agreement, loan agreement, security agreement, and all related agreements, instruments, certificates, and documents between or among Depositor and Secured Party (and any guarantors or other obligors party thereto), as the same may be amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, replaced, refinanced, or otherwise modified from time to time, including without limitation any intercreditor agreements, subordination agreements, and collateral documents executed in connection therewith.

**\"UCC\"** means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in the State of New York; provided that, to the extent that the UCC is used to define any term herein and such term is defined differently in different Articles or Divisions of the UCC, the definition of such term contained in Article 9 shall govern. In the event that, by reason of mandatory provisions of law, any of the attachment, perfection, or priority of the Secured Party\'s security interest in any Account is governed by the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted and in effect in a jurisdiction other than the State of New York, the term \"UCC\" shall mean the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted and in effect in such other jurisdiction solely for purposes of the provisions hereof relating to such attachment, perfection, or priority and for purposes of definitions relating to such provisions.

All other capitalized terms used in this Agreement and not specifically defined herein shall have the meanings assigned to such terms in the Loan Documents. To the extent a term is defined both in this Agreement and in the Loan Documents, the definition set forth in this Agreement shall control for purposes of this Agreement.
**[Section 2 --- The Accounts; Establishment of Control]{.underline}**

**2.1 Confirmation of Accounts.** Bank hereby confirms and acknowledges that (a) each Account listed on Schedule A hereto is maintained at Bank, (b) each such Account is held in the name of Depositor as the account holder of record, (c) each such Account constitutes a \"deposit account\" and/or \"securities account\" (as applicable) within the meaning of the UCC, and (d) Bank is the \"bank\" (as defined in UCC Section 9-102(a)(8)) with respect to each such Account.

**2.2 Establishment of Control.** Bank hereby agrees that, from and after the Effective Date, it will comply with Instructions originated by Secured Party directing the disposition of funds in the Accounts without further consent of Depositor, thereby establishing \"control\" by Secured Party over the Accounts within the meaning of UCC Sections 9-104(a)(2) and 8-106 (to the extent applicable). Bank acknowledges and agrees that such compliance obligation is unconditional and shall not be subject to any conditions precedent other than the delivery of such Instructions in a manner consistent with Section 10 of this Agreement. > \(a\) Bank shall immediately cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, and shall reject, refuse to honor, and return unpaid any checks, drafts, ACH debits, wire transfer requests, withdrawal requests, or other payment orders or instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor that are presented to or received by Bank on or after the date of Bank\'s compliance with the Notice of Exclusive Control;

> \(d\) Bank shall provide Secured Party with a complete and current statement of the balance and recent transaction history for each Account promptly upon request.

If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable in any respect under any applicable law, rule, or regulation in any jurisdiction, such invalidity, illegality, or unenforceability shall not affect the validity, legality, or enforceability of any other provision of this Agreement or the validity, legality, or enforceability of such provision in any other jurisdiction. In the event of any such determination, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to modify this Agreement so as to effect the original intent of the Parties as closely as possible in an acceptable manner, so that the transactions contemplated hereby are consummated as originally contemplated to the greatest extent possible.
**Section 12.7 --- Counterparts; Electronic Execution**

This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed to be an original, and all of which, when taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of a signature page to this Agreement by facsimile transmission, by electronic mail in \"portable document format\" (.pdf) form, or by any other electronic means intended to preserve the original graphic and pictorial appearance of a document, shall be effective as delivery of an originally executed counterpart of this Agreement. The words \"execution,\" \"signed,\" \"signature,\" and words of similar import in or relating to this Agreement shall be deemed to include electronic signatures, deliveries, or the keeping of records in electronic form, each of which shall be of the same legal effect, validity, or enforceability as a manually executed signature, physical delivery thereof, or the use of a paper-based recordkeeping system, to the extent and as provided for in any applicable law, including the Federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act, the New York State Electronic Signatures and Records Act, and any other similar state laws based on the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act.
**Section 12.8 --- Successors and Assigns**

This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of, the Parties hereto and their respective successors, legal representatives, and permitted assigns. Depositor may not assign, delegate, or transfer any of its rights, interests, or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Secured Party. Secured Party may freely assign, delegate, or transfer any or all of its rights, interests, and obligations under this Agreement, in whole or in part, to any successor, assignee, transferee, or participant under the Loan Documents or otherwise, without the consent of Depositor or Bank, and any such assignee or transferee shall thereupon be vested with all the rights, powers, and remedies of Secured Party hereunder as if originally named as Secured Party herein. Secured Party shall notify Bank in writing of any such assignment or transfer within a commercially reasonable time following the effectiveness thereof.
**Section 12.9 --- No Third-Party Beneficiaries**

This Agreement is for the sole and exclusive benefit of the Parties hereto and their respective successors and permitted assigns, and nothing contained in this Agreement, express or implied, is intended to or shall confer upon any other person or entity any legal or equitable right, benefit, remedy, or claim under or by reason of this Agreement.
**Section 12.10 --- Headings**

The headings, captions, and section titles contained in this Agreement are inserted for convenience of reference only and shall not affect the meaning, interpretation, or construction of any provision of this Agreement.

5: **[DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT]{.underline}**
6: 
7: This DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT (this \"Agreement\") is entered into as of \[DATE\], 20\_\_ (the \"Effective Date\"), by and among the following parties:
8: 
9: **SECURED PARTY:**
10: 
11: > Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, and its successors and assigns (the \"Secured Party\");
12: 
13: **DEPOSITOR / DEBTOR:**
14: 
15: > Graycliff Industries, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the \"Depositor\" or \"Debtor\"); and
16: 
17: **DEPOSITORY BANK:**
18: 
19: > Ironbridge National Bank, N.A., a national banking association chartered under the laws of the OCC Charter No. 18742 (the \"Bank\").
20: 
21: Each of the Secured Party, the Depositor, and the Bank is sometimes referred to herein individually as a \"Party\" and collectively as the \"Parties.\"
22: 
23: **[RECITALS]{.underline}**
24: 
25: **WHEREAS**, Depositor maintains one or more deposit accounts at Bank, each as more particularly identified and described on Schedule A attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference (collectively, the \"Accounts\" and each individually, an \"Account\");
26: 
27: **WHEREAS**, Secured Party has been granted a security interest in, and lien upon, such Accounts and all funds, cash, instruments, investment property, and other property at any time credited thereto, pursuant to that certain Credit Agreement dated as of April 14, 2025, by and between Depositor and Secured Party, with a maturity date of April 14, 2030, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, together with all related security agreements, pledge agreements, guaranties, and ancillary documents executed in connection therewith (collectively, the \"Loan Documents\");
28: 
29: **WHEREAS**, the Parties desire to enter into this Agreement to establish \"control\" (as such term is defined and used in Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of North Carolina) by the Secured Party over the Accounts in order to perfect the security interest of the Secured Party therein; and
30: 
31: **WHEREAS**, Bank is willing to enter into this Agreement on the terms and conditions set forth herein.
32: 
33: **NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the mutual covenants, representations, and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereby agree as follows:
34: 
35: **[Section 1 --- Definitions]{.underline}**
36: 
37: As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Loan Documents or, if not defined therein, in the UCC.
38: 
39: **\"Account\"** or **\"Deposit Account\"** means each deposit account identified on Schedule A hereto, including any and all renewals, replacements, or successor accounts thereof, and all funds, cash, instruments, and other property at any time credited to, deposited in, or otherwise attributable to any such account, together with all interest, income, and other earnings thereon and all proceeds (as defined in the UCC) thereof.
40: 
41: **\"Bank Obligations\"** means any and all obligations owed to Bank by Depositor, whether direct or contingent, now existing or hereafter arising, whether or not related to the Accounts.
42: 
43: **\"Business Day\"** means any day on which Bank is open for the conduct of substantially all of its commercial banking business at its offices in Charlotte, North Carolina, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and any day on which banking institutions in the State of North Carolina are authorized or required by law or executive order to close.
44: 
45: **\"Event of Default\"** means an \"Event of Default\" as defined in, and determined in accordance with, the Loan Documents, or as otherwise notified by Secured Party to Bank pursuant to a Notice of Exclusive Control delivered in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, Bank shall have no obligation or duty to independently determine whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Loan Documents.
46: 
47: **\"Exclusive Control Notice\"** or **\"Notice of Exclusive Control\"** (each, an **\"NOEC\"**) means a written notice delivered by Secured Party to Bank in accordance with Section 5 hereof, substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A (if any), asserting that an Event of Default has occurred under the Loan Documents and directing Bank to comply exclusively with Instructions originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, and to cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor.
48: 
49: **\"Instructions\"** means any order, direction, instruction, request, or authorization regarding the disposition of funds in, or any other action to be taken or omitted with respect to, any Account, including without limitation directions to initiate or execute wire transfers, ACH transactions, checks, withdrawals, transfers between accounts, account closings, and the provision of account statements, balance information, and other account-related information.
50: 
51: **\"Lien\"** means any security interest, lien, charge, encumbrance, claim, right of set-off, or other interest or right of any kind, whether arising by contract, operation of law, or otherwise.
52: 
53: **\"Loan Documents\"** means, collectively, the credit agreement, loan agreement, security agreement, and all related agreements, instruments, certificates, and documents between or among Depositor and Secured Party (and any guarantors or other obligors party thereto), as the same may be amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, replaced, or otherwise modified from time to time.
54: 
55: **\"UCC\"** means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in the State of North Carolina; provided that, to the extent that the UCC is used to define any term herein and such term is defined differently in different Articles or Divisions of the UCC, the definition of such term contained in Article 9 shall govern. In the event that, by reason of mandatory provisions of law, any of the attachment, perfection, or priority of the Secured Party\'s security interest in any Account is governed by the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted and in effect in a jurisdiction other than the State of North Carolina, the term \"UCC\" shall mean the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted and in effect in such other jurisdiction solely for purposes of the provisions hereof relating to such attachment, perfection, or priority and for purposes of definitions relating to such provisions.
56: 
57: All other capitalized terms used in this Agreement and not specifically defined herein shall have the meanings assigned to such terms in the Loan Documents. To the extent a term is defined both in this Agreement and in the Loan Documents, the definition set forth in this Agreement shall control for purposes of this Agreement.
58: 
59: **[Section 2 --- The Accounts; Establishment of Control]{.underline}**
60: 
61: **2.1 Confirmation of Accounts.** Bank hereby confirms and acknowledges that (a) each Account listed on Schedule A hereto is maintained at Bank, (b) each such Account is held in the name of Depositor as the account holder of record, (c) each such Account constitutes a \"deposit account\" within the meaning of the UCC, and (d) Bank is the \"bank\" (as defined in UCC Section 9-102(a)(8)) with respect to each such Account.
62: 
63: **2.2 Establishment of Control.** Bank hereby agrees that, from and after the Effective Date, it will comply with Instructions originated by Secured Party directing the disposition of funds in the Accounts without further consent of Depositor, thereby establishing \"control\" by Secured Party over the Accounts within the meaning of UCC Section 9-104(a)(2) . Bank acknowledges and agrees that such compliance obligation is unconditional and shall not be subject to any conditions precedent other than the delivery of such Instructions in a manner consistent with Section 10 of this Agreement. The Parties intend that this Agreement shall satisfy all requirements for the establishment and perfection of control by Secured Party over the Accounts under the UCC, and each Party agrees to take such further actions and execute such additional documents as may be reasonably necessary to effectuate such intent.
64: 
65: **2.3 No Changes to Accounts Without Consent.** Bank shall not, without the prior written consent of Secured Party, (a) change the name, account number, title, designation, or ownership of any Account, (b) close, terminate, or redesignate any Account, (c) open any new account for Depositor that is intended to be subject to this Agreement, (d) merge, combine, or consolidate any Account with any other account or obligation of Depositor at Bank, or (e) permit any change to the authorized signatories on any Account if such change has been objected to in writing by Secured Party.
66: 
67: **2.4 Depositor\'s Consent.** Depositor hereby irrevocably authorizes and consents to Bank\'s compliance with all Instructions originated by Secured Party, without any obligation of Bank to inquire into the right, authority, or entitlement of Secured Party to issue such Instructions, and without any obligation of Bank to provide notice to Depositor of its receipt or execution of any such Instructions. Depositor acknowledges that Bank shall have no liability to Depositor for complying with any Instruction originated by Secured Party in accordance with the terms of this Agreement.
68: 
69: **2.5 Depositor\'s Operating Rights Prior to Notice of Exclusive Control.** Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, unless and until Bank has received a Notice of Exclusive Control in accordance with Section 5, Depositor shall have the full and unrestricted right to issue Instructions to Bank with respect to the Accounts, including but not limited to directing the withdrawal, transfer, payment, and disposition of funds in the Accounts in the ordinary course of Depositor\'s business, without any requirement of consent or notification to Secured Party. Bank shall have no obligation to inquire whether any Instruction originated by Depositor prior to receipt of a NOEC is consistent with the Loan Documents, any standing instructions from Secured Party, or any other agreement between Depositor and Secured Party.
70: 
71: **[\[DELETED: Section 3 --- Exclusive Control Upon Event of Default\] \[ADDED: Section 3 --- Priority of Bank Set-Off Rights\]]{.underline}**
72: 
73: **3.1 Bank Priority.** Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, Bank\'s rights of set-off, recoupment, banker\'s lien, and security interest (whether arising by contract, law, or equity) in and against the Accounts and all funds therein shall at all times be prior and superior to any Instructions received from Secured Party and to any Lien or claim of Secured Party in the Accounts.
74: 
75: **3.2 Conflict Resolution.** In the event of any conflict between (i) Bank\'s exercise of its set-off, recoupment, or lien rights with respect to Bank Obligations and (ii) Instructions received from Secured Party, Bank\'s exercise of such rights shall prevail and Bank shall have no liability to Secured Party for complying with Bank\'s own rights in priority to Secured Party\'s Instructions.
76: 
77: **3.3 Notice of Exercise.** Bank shall use commercially reasonable efforts to notify Secured Party promptly following any exercise of set-off against the Accounts, but failure to provide such notice shall not affect the validity or priority of any such exercise.
78: 
79: \[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) Bank shall immediately cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, and shall reject, refuse to honor, and return unpaid any checks, drafts, ACH debits, wire transfer requests, withdrawal requests, or other payment orders or instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor that are presented to or received by Bank on or after the date of Bank\'s compliance with the Notice of Exclusive Control;
80: 
81: \(b\) Bank shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, including without limitation Instructions directing:

83: > \(i\) wire transfers of funds from any Account to any account designated by Secured Party;

87: > \(iii\) withdrawals of funds from any Account by any means;

103: \(b\) **Second:** Instructions of Depositor shall be given second priority and shall be complied with only to the extent (i) such Instructions are not inconsistent with, and do not conflict with, any Instructions previously or concurrently received from Secured Party, and (ii) no Notice of Exclusive Control is then in effect. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]
104: 
105: **4.1 Reservation of Set-Off Rights.** Bank reserves and retains the unrestricted right to set off, charge, debit, or apply funds in any Account against any obligation owed to Bank by Depositor, whether direct or contingent, now existing or hereafter arising, whether or not related to the Accounts, and whether matured or unmatured, liquidated or unliquidated, including without limitation obligations arising under any loan, credit facility, treasury management service, letter of credit, foreign exchange transaction, interest rate swap, or other agreement between Bank and Depositor (collectively, \"Bank Obligations\").
106: 
107: **4.2 No Prior Notice or Consent Required.** Bank may exercise such set-off right without prior notice to, or consent of, Secured Party or Depositor.
108:

110: 
111: \[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) Bank\'s standard published account maintenance fees, service charges, and transaction fees applicable to the Accounts in accordance with Bank\'s standard fee schedule as provided to Depositor from time to time in the ordinary course; and

114: 
115: *provided*, however, that in no event shall the aggregate amount of fees deducted or items charged back by Bank pursuant to clauses (a) and (b) above exceed \$**\_\_** in the aggregate during any calendar month without the prior written consent of Secured Party. Bank shall provide Secured Party with a monthly summary of all fees deducted and items charged back pursuant to this Section 5.3 promptly upon request. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

117: **5.1 Effect of Notice of Exclusive Control.** Upon receipt by Bank of a Notice of Exclusive Control from Secured Party delivered in accordance with Section 10 of this Agreement:
118: 
119: \[ADDED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) Bank shall cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, and shall reject, refuse to honor, and return unpaid any checks, drafts, ACH debits, wire transfer requests, withdrawal requests, or other payment orders or instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor that are presented to or received by Bank on or after the date of Bank\'s compliance with the Notice of Exclusive Control;
120: 
121: \(b\) Bank shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, including without limitation Instructions directing:
122: 
123: > \(i\) wire transfers of funds from any Account to any account designated by Secured Party;

125: > \(ii\) ACH debits and credits with respect to any Account;
126: >
127: > \(iii\) withdrawals of funds from any Account by any means;
